risks.if_unproven: Priced as high mileage and unknown age.

risks.risk: Donor vehicle make and model are unknown.
risks.proof: VIN plate or registration document from the vehicle it came from.

risks.risk: ECU, sensors, or gearbox may be missing.
risks.proof: Itemized photo or video showing every included component.
Borescope inspection video or teardown report.
Written warranty or return terms from the seller.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Photos of any engine stamps, codes, or part numbers.
Detailed photo showing ECU, sensors, harness, and gearbox if included.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a used car engine, so it can be priced at its worst case. Seller claims about fitment and quality cannot be confirmed from the photo and remain unproven.
